name: Stremio
short_description: Media center for streaming with addons - movies, shows, and video content.
description: Stremio is a media center application that lets you discover and watch videos. It supports movies, TV shows, and video content through community-built addons. The server version allows you to host your own streaming backend. Features include addons for various content sources, library for...
usecases: Discover new movies and shows through addons.
notes: HTTP and HTTPS are served by the bundled Caddy reverse proxy.
